patterns.component_pattern: UI components use 'use client', forwardRef, TypeScript interfaces, variant-based styling
patterns.styling_pattern: Tailwind CSS with dark mode support (dark: prefix)
patterns.export_pattern: Export from components/ui/index.ts for centralized imports
patterns.accessibility_pattern: Use role='alert' for alert messages, proper ARIA attributes
patterns.typescript_pattern: Strict TypeScript with interfaces for props, Record types for variant styles
